description: This file defines the Font class used for parsing font-related styles from XML in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for parsing underline styles, vertical alignment, and other font attributes from XML elements.

classes.name: Font
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing font style attributes from XML elements within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: parseUnderline
methods.description: Parses the underline style from the XML attribute and updates the style array accordingly.

methods.name: parseVerticalAlign
methods.description: Parses vertical alignment attributes (Superscript/Subscript) from the XML and updates the style array.

methods.name: parseStyle
methods.description: Main method to parse various font styles (name, size, color, bold, italic, underline, vertical alignment) from given XML attributes.
